label: Simulation on synthetic data. A model, not a measurement

assumption.status: approved by the CEO seat on the founder's behalf, 2026-11-15 (an assumption, not a measurement)
assumption.text: We assume that each match lowers the chance of a wrong or missed diagnosis by 10%, rising to 20% as matches accumulate.

matches.label: Records with a match
matches.definition: opted-in records in the sample with at least one match (k = 5, at least 4 shared codes)

series.label: Records that find a match
series.origin: computed by running the matching logic on cohort samples of growing size

series.label: Wrong or missed diagnoses
series.status: approved by the CEO seat on the founder's behalf, 2026-11-15 (an assumption, not a measurement)
series.formula: 5 x (1 - effect x match_rate), effect = 0.10 + 0.10 x (matches so far / matches in the full synthetic network)

sources.name: WHO, Patient safety fact sheet, 11 Sep 2023 (5-20% of physician-patient encounters; low end used)

series.label: Cost of wrong or missed diagnoses
series.status: approved by the CEO seat on the founder's behalf, 2026-11-15 (an assumption, not a measurement)
series.formula: 11 x (1 - effect x match_rate), effect = 0.10 + 0.10 x (matches so far / matches in the full synthetic network)

sources.name: OECD Health Working Paper No. 176, The economics of diagnostic safety, 2025 (about 11% of health spending; an OECD model estimate)

euro.formula: drop_pts / 100 x 1833973.32 EUR million (EU-27 current health expenditure, 2024); drop_pts = 11 - cost, cost at 2 decimals

source.name: Eurostat, current health expenditure (hlth_sha11_hf, all financing schemes), EU-27, 2024
